dynamics.about: Voicing for Gesang der Apollopriesterin (piano reduction), from Strauss's full score: the strings' repeated-chord pulse kept back; the muted cellos' figure (bars 1-26, 40-42) and the timpani rolls (78, 88-99) as a soft blanket; the string tremolo at the climaxes (56-70, 107-113) left full; the top moving line of the right hand (brass fanfares, solo violin, clarinet, cellos' line) brought out and slightly ahead; pedal changed with the harmony.
